title: Build a semaphore
summary: A counting semaphore made of a mutex, a condition and a counter.
hints: `struct sem { pthread_mutex_t m; pthread_cond_t c; int count; };`. `my_wait`: lock, `while (count == 0) cond_wait`, `count--`, unlock. `my_post`: lock, `count++`, `cond_signal`, unlock.
Then use it exactly like `sem_t` with initial value 1 to protect the counter in the threads.
